order: Original full study case order, filtered solely by capacity_matched and seed22/23, frozen before new ratings; no outcome filtering.
instructions:
Read ONLY this public packet and its referenced original PNGs in a fresh context. Do not read private mappings, registries, method/native-unit/category identities, previous descriptions, numerical scores, other raters' labels or unrelated files. No browsing or subagents. Actually inspect every full sheet and every zoom strip at original resolution before rating. The PNG header mentions image pairs from an earlier task: IGNORE that pair instruction. Judge ONE overarching motif across ALL SIX numbered marked regions together, not three separate pair themes. Objects outside the marked patches do not establish a match. Parts, textures, geometric structures, materials, contexts, relations and cross-category motifs are legitimate themes. An unnamed repeated motif is not automatically incoherent, but do not stretch a vague theme to cover unrelated examples. Choose a single best-supported theme of at most30 words, list every matching view (1–6), and explain exceptions. Broad or generic motifs may be coherent; rate specificity separately.

Use the earlier five-of-six group rubric: valid HIGH examples have nonzero native responses (the frozen per-view metadata supplies validity). If fewer than4 valid HIGH examples, coherence=insufficient_evidence. With adequate readable evidence, clear means one recognizable motif fits at least ceil(5*valid_HIGH/6); partial means a motif fits at least ceil(valid_HIGH/2) but does not reach clear; no_clear_theme means no recognizable motif fits half the valid HIGH regions after allowing parts, texture, geometry, context and relations. With six valid views: clear=5or6 matches; partial=3or4; no_clear_theme=0to2. Resolution/occlusion that prevents judgment is insufficient_evidence, never an invented no or yes. A collection of unrelated pair-specific themes does NOT make the overall group clear.

Specificity is independent: specific / broad_but_discriminating / generic_nondiscriminating / unclear. Record confidence high / medium / low. Exceptions must list all valid views not fitting the proposed single theme, and explain competing meanings or uncertain marked detail. LOW-response images are not supplied in this supplemental task: high_low_contrast must remain not_assessed; do not infer contrast or specificity against negatives. Do not infer model identity. Return the exact output template with your actual fresh reviewer ID and provenance. Write your completed actual JSON atomically via .tmp then rename, so unfinished labels cannot be accepted. These are AI review replicates, not independent human raters.

original_protocol.sampling: Every native group from all matched75 seed21 banks; full-category4 and category-split5. Native SLiCS37/38 and ConceptSAE111 excluded from this matched endpoint.
original_protocol.evidence: Exact original strongest-six audit PNGs and patch positions, copied byte-for-byte. No image replacement or new model inference. Printed pair header superseded by whole-group instructions.
original_protocol.primary: Groups rated clear by at least two of three fresh blinded AI reviewers / all native groups. Unknowns remain in denominator.
original_protocol.secondary: Majority-clear AND at least two independent specificity ratings specific or broad_but_discriminating / all native groups; report both component distributions, no weighted composite.

original_protocol.differences: Same five-of-six HIGH rubric, different checkpoints and image pool from old pilot. LOW images absent so high_low_contrast not_assessed. Supplemental endpoint requested after pair results; not an independent confirmatory allocation.
original_protocol.reporting: Separate full-category and category split, each fold and combined equal-fold means; shared Vanilla counted once. Single seed, AI-majority labels not independent human validation. Do not change prior pair scores or paper automatically.

primary: At least two of three clear votes / all native groups; unknowns and unresolved votes remain in denominator.
secondary: Majority clear AND at least two specific or broad_but_discriminating specificity ratings / all native groups.
completion_gate: Explicit start assignment, actual agent FINAL observed by root, finish receipt with finalized raw hash and FINAL text hash, then explicit accept. File presence alone never imports labels.
concurrency: At most3 local active assignments; root coordinates total active agents across whole and pair work.
reporting: Per seed/bank/fold and seed-method equal-fold means; aggregate equal-seed means and full distributions; shared category-split Vanilla counted once. Seed21 reuse is not fresh review. AI replicates are not independent human validation. No LOW contrast.
